tasks.label: Android: Launch App
args: & { $id = (& .\tools\android_env.ps1).Trim(); if(-not $id){ Write-Error 'applicationId missing'; exit 1 }; adb shell monkey -p $id 1 }

tasks.label: Android: Full Run
args: Write-Output 'Android: Full Run completed (logcat running in dedicated panel)'; exit 0
